items.question: What exactly does ReportFlow Engine automate?
items.answer: It automatically collects data from your marketing platforms, generates AI powered performance summaries, creates visual dashboards, and delivers reports to your clients on schedule. Everything that takes your team hours every week happens automatically.

items.question: How quickly can I start saving time?
items.answer: Implementation takes 3 to 5 business days. Once live, you immediately stop spending hours on manual data collection and report creation. Most agencies see the full 23+ hours saved within the first month.

items.question: Which marketing platforms can you connect?
items.answer: We can connect virtually any platform your agency uses. Advertising platforms, analytics tools, social media, CRM systems, email marketing tools. If it has data you need to report on, we can pull it in automatically.

items.question: What reports will I receive?
items.answer: You get automated dashboards showing all your marketing performance data in one place. The system generates AI powered summaries of what is working and what needs attention. You can access real time dashboards anytime or receive scheduled report summaries via email.

items.question: Do I need to change how I work with clients?
items.answer: No. The system works behind the scenes. Your client communication stays the same, but you spend zero time building reports. You focus on strategy and optimization while automation handles the reporting.

items.question: What happens if I need to add new data sources?
items.answer: We handle it. As your agency adds new tools or platforms, we integrate them into your reporting system. This is included in the ongoing support, no additional setup process needed.

general.title: Frequently Asked Questions
general.subtitle: Everything you need to know about working with SeventeenLabs

items.question: Is this right for my business size?
items.answer: Our automations work for businesses of all sizes. Whether you're a solo consultant spending 10 hours/week on manual tasks or a 50-person agency, we can help. We've worked with everyone from solopreneurs to enterprise teams.

items.question: How long until I see results?
items.answer: Most automations are live within 2-4 weeks. You'll start saving time immediately after deployment. Simple integrations can be done even faster—sometimes in just a few days.

items.question: What if it doesn't work for my workflow?
items.answer: We start with a free audit to ensure automation makes sense for you. If we can't deliver meaningful results, we'll tell you upfront. Plus, we include 30 days of adjustments to make sure everything works perfectly.

items.question: Do I need technical knowledge?
items.answer: Not at all. We handle all the technical setup and configuration. You just tell us what you want automated, and we make it happen. We'll train your team on using the final system—it's typically as simple as clicking a button.

items.question: What happens after the initial setup?
items.answer: All our automations include 30 days of free adjustments and tweaks. After that, we offer ongoing support packages if you need help maintaining or expanding your automations. Many clients run independently after the initial setup.

items.question: Can you integrate with my existing tools?
items.answer: Probably yes! We work with 1000+ apps through n8n, including all major platforms (Google Workspace, HubSpot, Salesforce, Slack, Stripe, etc.). If your tool has an API, we can connect it.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: Our Beta Pilot Program starts at €990 for your first automation (50% off our regular rate). This includes discovery, implementation, and 30 days of support. Custom projects are quoted after a free audit call.

items.question: What's included in the Beta Pilot Program?
items.answer: You get a free automation audit (30-min call), one fully working automation deployed to your business, 30 days of tweaks and support, and early access to new solutions. Plus you save 50% vs our regular pricing.
